land.headline: Is your car care quote fair?
land.sub: Enter your car and your quote. In 30 seconds, see if it's low, fair, or high based on real Phoenix prices.
land.services: Tint · Detailing · Ceramic coating · Body work · Starlight · Oil change · Lighting
veh.type.q: What type of vehicle is it?
quote.skip: I don't have a quote yet
step.reassure: Your info stays private. No shop will call you unless you ask.
teaser.line.high: Your quote looks higher than what most Phoenix shops charge for a {year} {model}.
teaser.line.fair: Your quote is in the normal range for a {year} {model} in Phoenix.
teaser.line.low: Your quote is below the usual range. That can be a great deal, or a sign of cheaper materials.
teaser.line.noquote: We have the Phoenix price range for your {year} {model}.
gate.headline: Where do I send your full price report?
gate.bullets: ✓ The exact low, typical, and high price for your car
✓ How much you'd save, or overpay
✓ This week's Phoenix car care deals
gate.name: First name
gate.consent: Send me the free weekly Phoenix car care deals email. Unsubscribe anytime.
gate.privacy: We never sell your email. No spam, no calls.
gate.zip.error: We only cover the Phoenix area right now. We'll still email your report.
result.headline: {first_name}, here's your Phoenix price report
result.diff.high: That's ${quote − typical} more than the typical Phoenix price.
result.diff.fair: You're right in the normal range.
result.diff.low: That's ${typical − quote} under typical. Ask which film or product they're using.
result.drivers.title: What changes the price for your car
result.drivers: Vehicle size · Film or product brand · Warranty length · Prep work
result.emailnote: We also sent this report to {email}.
cta.quotes.headline: Want a better price?
cta.quotes.sub: We'll send your request to up to 3 vetted Phoenix shops. They text you a quote. You decide.
quotes.timing.q: When are you hoping to get it done?
quotes.consent: By tapping Get My Quotes, I agree that up to 3 local car care shops may contact me by call or text about my request, including by automated means. Consent isn't required to buy. Msg and data rates may apply.
quotes.thanks: Done. Expect a text from local shops soon. Your deals email arrives every week.

gate.disclosure: You'll also get our free weekly Phoenix deals. Unsubscribe anytime.
